verdict.rationale: Mollie exposes a comprehensive documented REST API (payments, subscriptions, refunds, balances, connect, webhooks) with authentication, idempotency, and testing support, plus a full llms.txt/markdown documentation mirror explicitly built for AI-native consumption and an official hosted MCP server proxying the public API. This clearly satisfies an AI-native user driving the product programmatically. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found only 404s) and independent third-party corroboration of API usability beyond Mollie's own docs.
